verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an in-dashboard AI Assistant, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows Supabase only in the MCP server role: it offers its own hosted and local MCP server for external agents, plus a guide for hosting your own MCP servers on Edge Functions. Hosting or serving MCP is not consuming it, and nothing documents the Assistant or any other Supabase component connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
